target.title: fix(control-ui): show unavailable sizes for negative byte counts
target.body:
﻿## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users viewing Control UI status details could see a negative byte count rendered as a normal byte-size value when the UI formatter receives an invalid negative metric.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Control UI byte-size formatter now treats negative byte counts the same as missing or non-finite values and renders them as `-`. Existing zero and positive byte-size formatting remains unchanged.

## User Impact

Users now see an unavailable value instead of a misleading negative byte-size label when Control UI receives an invalid negative count.

## Evidence

Focused regression coverage added:
- `formatBytes(-1)` returns `-`
- existing positive byte formatting assertions remain unchanged

Validation:
- `git diff --check` passed
- `pnpm --dir ui test -- src/lib/agents/display.test.ts` was attempted locally, but the command ran the full UI suite and hit local environment failures unrelated to this diff: Chinese locale-formatted strings, missing Playwright Chromium, and a pre-existing Vite alias assertion. No production files outside `ui/src/lib/agents/display.ts` and `ui/src/lib/agents/display.test.ts` were changed.

AI-assisted: drafted and validated with Codex; I reviewed the change and understand the behavior.
